Read this sentence from paragraph 10.

But Layla could not ignore the heavy feeling that had settled in her heart.

The imagery in this sentence suggests that Layla feels —

options.label: A
options.text: angry, because she doesn’t like what she is thinking to herself

options.label: B
options.text: uncomfortable, because she knows that she is making a mistake

options.label: C
options.text: curious, because she wants to study the rock and learn more about it

options.label: D
options.text: proud, because she realizes that she is the one who found an unusual rock
